mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at the Verona Area High School and a pleasant temperature of 78 degrees. If you are out tonight, keep an eye on the sky as the ISS will be visible starting at 9:05 PM for 2 minutes, passing from the southwest near Mount Horeb toward the east northeast near Fitchburg and Madison, while the moon is in a waning crescent phase.

The Verona Police Department has reported that on Sunday, August 30, 2026, they received information regarding an inappropriate relationship between a teacher and a student that occurred in 2019. Following an investigation, 34-year-old Halla Nelson of Madison was arrested on September 4 and booked into the Dane County jail on one count of sexual assault of a child by a school staff member. The investigation remains open.

We have a busy week ahead! Today, you can join Yoga at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow, we have several trivia events at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead to Wednesday, enjoy trivia at The Mill, The Bogey Factory, or live music and pizza specials at various local venues.
In a recent report, the Verona Police Department confirmed an arrest for a sexual assault case involving a school staff member that occurred on Sunday, August 30, 2026.
Culver's is currently open until 10:00 PM today, so be sure to stop in and enjoy the delicious Georgia Peach flavor of the day.
